Honoring this divine figure with a personal name not only connects the individual to their spiritual roots but also enhances their cultural identity. The name Honansh instills a sense of courage, resilience, and devotion within the bearer, helping them overcome adversity and challenging situations in life. It also serves as a reminder of Lord Hanuman's legendary feats, including his ability to traverse vast distances in a short time, his indestructible strength, and his unwavering loyalty.

He is credited with the authorship of the 'Honanshagadiprabandha' which is a commentary on the 'Tattvartha Sutra'. This work is of great significance to the Jaina community as it expounds on the doctrine of Karma and the attainment of moksha (liberation).
